name: Summit AZ - Search Atlas Progress vs Baseline 2026-07-21
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-07-21

# Summary
Two-page progress report one day after the 2026-07-20 baseline audit: 3 fixed or verified, 1 in progress, 2 pending.

# Changes
- Header menu redirects: 4 city links (Apache Junction, Chandler, Fountain Hills, San Tan Valley) were 301ing on every page; now return 200 sitewide (about 168 pages). FIXED.
- Broken links: re-crawl of 165 pages found 0; the "11" was stale Jul 5 data. RESOLVED.
- Areas We Serve body links: 6 (+2) still 301, per page. PENDING.
- Orphan pages (4): OPEN.
- Sitemap "broken" flag from the connector was false. RESOLVED.
- Tempe page: new SEO title "Emergency Plumber in Tempe, AZ | 24/7 Summit Plumbing Pros" and meta live; H1, intro, 6 H2s, FAQ and schema in progress or pending.
- Mobile performance (WebP, compression) and Domain Power 10: not started.

# Open items
1. Finish the Tempe page in a guided Elementor session.
2. Decide on the Areas We Serve links (leave or Better Search Replace after backup).
3. Authority building.
4. WebP conversion and compression.
